name: CMC Alpha Terminal
tagline: Institutional Quantitative Crypto Intelligence & Alpha Screener for Anna AI OS
description:
CMC Alpha Terminal brings hedge-fund grade quantitative analytics and crypto screening directly into the Anna AI OS desktop.

### Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Factor Cross-Sectional Momentum:** Rank top crypto assets by short-term (24h) and medium-term (7d) returns, volume weighting, and market capitalization scaling.
- **Parkinson Realized Volatility Regimes:** Real-time extreme-value Parkinson volatility estimation to classify market regimes into COMPRESSION (breakout watch), TRENDING (momentum), or EXPANSION_VOLATILE (risk alert).
- **Turnover & Liquidity Depth Analysis:** Measure 24h volume-to-market-cap velocity to classify execution slippage and liquidity risk tiers.
- **Market Breadth & Dominance Tracking:** Track real-time market advance/decline ratios, Bitcoin dominance, and global DeFi liquidity.

### Direct Host & Chat Integration
Interact via natural language in Anna chat or through the dedicated glassmorphic desktop terminal window.
